delivered.body: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital, LLC and Oakstone Ventures, Inc. 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential information. 2. CONSIDERATION. The receiving party shall protect disclosed information for a period of three years. 4. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing, and all obligations regarding confidential information shall survive the termination of this Agreement for an additional three years. 4. REMEDIES. Breach may be enjoined and damages sought.
